title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-04-13
summary: Weekly engineering update for Private Deployments covering VPC/on-prem installs, customer blockers, and action items for next week.
body:
Private Deployments — Weekly Update (coverage: 2026-04-07 to 2026-04-13)

Owner: Asha Patel | Compiled: 2026-04-13 | Last mod: 2026-04-14
Attendees (weekly sync 2026-04-13): Asha, Liam, Marcos, Sofia, Rachel, Diego (joined 20m)

Top-level highlights:
- Several in-flight customer VPC onboards progressing; one major blocker remains (network peering + customer firewall rules).
- Air-gapped/on-prem install for MedCorp hit NVIDIA driver mismatch on their older GPU nodes; workaround identified and being tested.
- Private installer PR #87 passed basic e2e; targeting canary rollouts to two staging clusters next week.
- Action items ordered by priority at the bottom.

Standups / day-by-day notes:
- 2026-04-07 (Mon):
  - Sprint kickoff: aligned on installers backlog and customer escalations.
  - Customer FinServ Co: initial VPC peering completed (account team), but customer firewall blocks outbound 443->redwood-control-plane (JIRA PD-1123). Need exact IP ranges and SNI hostnames.
  - Action: Liam to confirm ephemeral IP ranges with infra and share with customer by 2026-04-08.

- 2026-04-08 (Tue):
  - MedCorp on-prem: installer failed during driver check (reported CUDA toolkit mismatch). Marcos reproduced locally on k8s-jenkins and proposed bundling a compatibility-check script.
  - Action: Marcos to add compatibility-check (ETA 2026-04-09) and create KB for SREs.

- 2026-04-09 (Wed):
  - Private installer PR #87 (fixes race in kv-cache init) merged to staging. Smoke tests passed but one flake noted in long-sequence generation test.
  - Customer RetailX: VPC peering done, but routing asymmetry caused healthcheck failures; SRE adjusted route table — monitoring.

- 2026-04-10 (Thu):
  - Deep-dive with Security (Sofia) on HSM/KMS integration for FinServ Co. Confirmed they require key import policy + rotation auditing. Need to surface these requirements in onboarding checklist.
  - Action: Sofia + Rachel to update onboarding checklist (Confluence PD-42) by 2026-04-14.

- 2026-04-11 (Fri):
  - Canary plan drafted for private-installer v0.9.3. Canary targets: staging-a, staging-b. If no regressions in 48h, promote to production-candidates for customer installs.
  - Noted one persistent customer-blocker: PD-1130 (FinServ Co) — customer-side network policy blocking gRPC health pings to model nodes.

Current customer-specific status and blockers:
- FinServ Co (high priority) — VPC + HSM
  - Status: Peering established; control-plane comms failing intermittently.
  - Blocker: Customer network team is blocking outbound traffic to a small set of IPs used by our control-plane (JIRA PD-1130). They want a fixed IP list and FQDNs.
  - Action items:
    - Liam to provide accurate IP ranges and SNI/FQDN list by 2026-04-14.
    - Sofia to prepare HSM/KMS integration checklist and required logs for audit by 2026-04-14.
  - Notes: Customer requires key import policy — our Private Control Plane must expose import endpoint (security review done, changes scoped).

- MedCorp (medium priority) — on-prem, air-gapped
  - Status: Installer runs but fails driver validation on their legacy GPU nodes.
  - Blocker: Customer cannot upgrade drivers immediately (change window constraints).
  - Workaround: Introduce compatibility-check script + optional legacy-driver-compat shim that disables a few perf-sensitive kernels.
  - Action: Marcos to push compatibility-check + shim branch and coordinate with solutions-eng for a staged install next Tuesday (2026-04-20).

- RetailX (low priority) — VPC
  - Status: Routing asymmetry caused intermittent healthcheck failures; fixed by SRE route-table change. Monitoring looks stable.
  - No action required unless further incidents.

Operational / Release notes:
- private-installer v0.9.3 highlights: KV-cache race fix, improved healthcheck retry logic, added verbose logs for peering step.
- Canary plan: deploy to staging-a & staging-b (2026-04-14), watch 48h. If no regressions, deploy to prod-candidate clusters (2026-04-16).
- Metrics to watch during canary: install success rate, time-to-ready, healthcheck failures, long-sequence generation flakiness.

Risks & mitigation:
- Risk: FinServ Co blocking control-plane endpoints could delay full onboarding by 2+ weeks if IP list negotiation stalls.
  - Mitigation: Offer short-term VPN jumpbox / bastion to proxy control-plane traffic (requires security signoff).
- Risk: MedCorp legacy drivers may require longer support window.
  - Mitigation: Implement shim and document performance tradeoffs; request temporary exception window from customer.

Action items (owner — due date):
- Liam Chen — provide final IP/SNI list for FinServ Co (2026-04-14) [JIRA PD-1130].
- Sofia Ivanova & Rachel Kim — update onboarding checklist with HSM/KMS audit steps (2026-04-14) [Confluence PD-42].
- Marcos Rivera — push compatibility-check + legacy-driver shim branch and coordinate test install with solutions-eng (2026-04-16).
- Asha Patel — schedule security review for control-plane proxy option and cost estimate for temporary VPN bastion (2026-04-15).
- Diego Morales — run extended long-sequence generation test on staging after canary deploy (start 2026-04-14).

Notes / loose threads:
- Need clear doc for customers describing IP ranges vs. FQDNs vs. VPN options; current collateral scattered across Confluence pages.
- Consider adding a firewall-friendly mode to control-plane with reduced port requirements (design spike in backlog).
- Follow-up: solutions-eng to prepare customer-facing one-pager for FinServ Co that outlines steps and timelines; target 2026-04-15.

Meeting logs / references:
- Weekly sync recording: internal dropbox link (recording archived) 
- Confluence onboarding draft: CONFLUENCE-PD-42
- Key tickets: JIRA PD-1123 (FinServ firewall), JIRA PD-1130 (control-plane comms), JIRA PD-1141 (installer flake)

Closing notes:
- Overall momentum good; biggest near-term lift is wrangling network policy with FinServ Co. If Liam can deliver IP/FQDN list and Security signs off on HSM checklist this week, we should unblock their onboarding.
- Please update ticket comments as actions complete and ping Asha for any escalations.

-- End of update --
